name: HUI
subtitle: Your HUI gateway, on the phone
description: HUI on the phone: the shell around your own gateway's web UI, which asks for the address of the gateway you run (https:// through `tailscale serve`). It bundles no copy of the UI and keeps no account of its own. This IPA is unsigned: SideStore signs it with your Apple ID, which lasts seven days and is renewed by SideStore (see HUI's user guide).
